social_accounts_expiry_idx.name: social_accounts_expiry_idx
social_accounts_expiry_idx.where: "social_accounts"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "social_accounts"."status" = 'active' AND "social_accounts"."credentials_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

activity_events_kind_outcome.name: activity_events_kind_outcome
activity_events_kind_outcome.value: (kind = 'target_published' AND outcome = 'published') OR (kind = 'target_failed' AND outcome = 'failed') OR (kind = 'target_ambiguous' AND outcome = 'ambiguous') OR (kind = 'target_retry_scheduled' AND outcome = 'retrying') OR (kind = 'target_resolved' AND outcome = 'resolved') OR (kind = 'account_needs_reauth' AND outcome = 'needs_reauth') OR (kind = 'account_connect_failed' AND outcome = 'connect_failed')

activity_events_target_kinds.name: activity_events_target_kinds
activity_events_target_kinds.value: ("activity_events"."kind"::text NOT LIKE 'target_%' OR ("activity_events"."post_target_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_events"."social_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activity_events"."provider_key" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("activity_events"."kind"::text NOT LIKE 'account_%' OR "activity_events"."post_target_id" IS NULL)

api_idempotency_keys_lock_state.name: api_idempotency_keys_lock_state
api_idempotency_keys_lock_state.value: ("api_idempotency_keys"."state" = 'in_progress') = ("api_idempotency_keys"."lock_token" IS NOT NULL AND "api_idempotency_keys"."hold_until" IS NOT NULL)

api_idempotency_keys_completed_state.name: api_idempotency_keys_completed_state
api_idempotency_keys_completed_state.value: ("api_idempotency_keys"."state" = 'completed') = ("api_idempotency_keys"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "api_idempotency_keys"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

api_keys_revoker_implies_revoked.name: api_keys_revoker_implies_revoked
api_keys_revoker_implies_revoked.value: "api_keys"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL OR "api_keys"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

connect_attempts_completed_after_callbac.name: connect_attempts_completed_after_callback
connect_attempts_completed_after_callbac.value: "connect_attempts"."completed_at" is null or "connect_attempts"."callback_at" is not null

connect_attempts_candidates_after_callba.name: connect_attempts_candidates_after_callback
connect_attempts_candidates_after_callba.value: "connect_attempts"."candidates_encrypted" is null or "connect_attempts"."callback_at" is not null

media_assets_video_ready_facts.name: media_assets_video_ready_facts
media_assets_video_ready_facts.value: "media_assets"."kind" <> 'video' OR "media_assets"."processing_state" <> 'ready' OR ("media_assets"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."video_codec" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."container" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media_assets"."height" IS NOT NULL)

video_versions_ready_facts.name: video_versions_ready_facts
video_versions_ready_facts.value: "video_versions"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("video_versions"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."public_url" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."container" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."duration_ms" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."frame_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."video_codec" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."video_bitrate" IS NOT NULL AND "video_versions"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL)

post_targets_live_has_schedule.name: post_targets_live_has_schedule
post_targets_live_has_schedule.value: "post_targets"."status" NOT IN ('scheduled','publishing') OR ("post_targets"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_targets"."scheduled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "post_targets"."schedule_kind" IS NOT NULL)

post_targets_published_has_id.name: post_targets_published_has_id
post_targets_published_has_id.value: "post_targets"."status" <> 'published' OR "post_targets"."external_id" IS NOT NULL OR "post_targets"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL

posts_generation_request_uq.name: posts_generation_request_uq
posts_generation_request_uq.where: "posts"."generation_request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

posts_series_position_uq.name: posts_series_position_uq
posts_series_position_uq.where: "posts"."series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

posts_generation_job_item_uq.name: posts_generation_job_item_uq
posts_generation_job_item_uq.where: "posts"."generation_job_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "posts"."deleted_at" IS NULL

generation_jobs_finished_set.name: generation_jobs_finished_set
generation_jobs_finished_set.value: "generation_jobs"."status" NOT IN ('completed','completed_with_failures') OR "generation_jobs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL

webhook_delivery_attempts_outcome.name: webhook_delivery_attempts_outcome
webhook_delivery_attempts_outcome.value: "webhook_delivery_attempts"."status_code" IS NOT NULL OR "webhook_delivery_attempts"."error_kind" IS NOT NULL
